mcq_drop.why: 'according to APPSC keys' wording; district ambiguous (Bhairavakona now in Prakasam)

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: 'Vichitrachitta' is a title of Mahendravarman I, not Narasimhavarman I

patterns: Builder identification dominates: rathas = Narasimhavarman I (Mamalla); Shore Temple and Kailasanatha = Narasimhavarman II.
Superlatives asked directly: Draupadi ratha smallest; rock-cut temples of Mahabalipuram = Pallavas.
Ruler titles (Vichitrachitta, Mamalla, Rajasimha) are an APPSC favourite trap.
AP tilt: Undavalli caves = Vishnukundins (APPSC G2 2025), not Cholas.
App MCQs are broader (statement sets on rathas, Kanchi, Sittannavasal) than the single-fact PYQs.
